question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Schwab's financial consultant career achievement plan provides for earned cash payments after retirement for eligible financial consultants, contingent upon meeting certain performance levels, tenure, age, and client transitioning requirements.
items.quote: A financial consultant is eligible for earned cash payments after retirement contingent upon meeting certain performance levels, tenure, age, and client transitioning requirements.

items.text: Full vesting under the financial consultant career achievement plan occurs when a financial consultant reaches 60 years of age and has at least ten years of service; this includes 'client transitioning requirements' as a condition of eligibility.
items.quote: Among other conditions, full vesting occurs when a financial consultant reaches 60 years of age and has at least ten years of service with the Company.

items.text: Schwab's Advisor Services offers services to help advisors establish their own independent practices and supports them through transition with access to business start-up and transition consultants, technology engineers, and dedicated service teams.
items.quote: We also offer an array of services to help advisors establish their own independent practices through a robust prospect consulting offer. To support them throughout their transition, we offer access to business start-up and transition consultants, technology engineers, and dedicated service teams.

items.text: Schwab sees a 'succession gap threat' among RIAs, as noted in trade press headlines relating to Schwab; one RIA advisor (a partner) whose principal is 65 has yet to decide upon a succession plan.
items.quote: He is 65, she said, and has yet to decide upon a succession plan, a problem she and the other partners are wrestling with how to address
items.unit: age of RIA principal without succession plan
items.scope: individual RIA using Schwab as custodian

items.text: Schwab is hiring financial consultants and wealth advisers while expanding its branch footprint, with about a dozen new branches planned for 2026.
items.quote: We're continuing to hire financial consultants and wealth advisers while expanding our branch footprint with about a dozen new branches planned for 2026.

items.text: Schwab's 2026 spending plan includes adding more financial consultants and wealth advisors.
items.quote: Select examples for 2026 include investing in branches, adding more financial consultants and wealth advisors, advertising and marketing

items.text: Schwab plans to hire 'thousands more financial consultants' to serve retail investors across its 400 branches.
items.quote: In a letter published earlier this month from Chuck Schwab, the company said it plans to hire 'thousands more financial consultants' to serve retail investors across its 400 branches

items.text: In 2024 Schwab executed 'our long-standing and thoughtful succession planning' in leadership transitions.
items.quote: It was also a year of leadership transitions where we executed on our long-standing and thoughtful succession planning.

items.text: Schwab offers Wealth.com's estate planning tools to its clients to integrate estate planning into their investment life, and in 2025 began rolling out their estate analysis capability to specialists.
items.quote: We took an ownership stake in Wealth.com and began rolling out their estate analysis capability to our specialists, giving us more tools to help clients integrate their estate planning into their investment life.

cells.reason: The passages describe Schwab's financial consultant retirement/vesting plan with client transitioning requirements, services helping RIAs transition/succeed their practices, succession gap threats, and efforts to hire financial consultants and wealth advisors, and succession planning at executive level.
